Mulberry Group Sales Get Boost From Reduced Discounts
Mulberry Group said sales in its fiscal first half got a boost from reduced promotional activity and that it would continue to focus on driving full-price growth in the second half.

Sales for the half year ended Sept. 26 were up 18% compared with the year-earlier period, the British luxury company said. The company said it generated strong full-price sales that supported its gross margin performance, but didn't disclose profit figures.
Mulberry said first-half performance was in line with its board's expectations.

The company remains focused on restoring profitability and still targets annual revenue of more than 200 million pounds ($266.6 million) and an adjusted earnings before interest and tax margin of 15% over the medium term, it said.
